title: Fix ordered branch exclusions in the selected replay CI guard
body:
## Summary

The selected-replay CI guard accepted `branches: [main, '!main']` and reported complete trigger coverage, although GitHub excludes main. Reuse the guard's existing ordered glob matcher for branch inclusion, preserving its explicit-main restriction and advisory default.

```diff
 branches: [main, '!m*']
- --require-triggers: exit 0, PASS_SELECTED_CI_INPUTS
+ --require-triggers: exit 1, push branch filter excludes main
```

Add three regression groups and a [scoped evidence note](research/selected-ci-branch-order/README.md). This follows Sagar Thakrar's guard in #1361 and [Discussion #2926](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2926). The current workflow passes; no missed hosted run is claimed. No construction, source archive, selected record or kappa changes.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the actual guard CLI passes with an edited selected workflow that excludes main. The final regression tests reject the base guard with 22 failing subtests.
- **After:** the same CLI rejects exclusions for push and pull_request, including under optimized execution. Later re-inclusion passes. Eight CLI controls also verify the advisory default against a complete small repository fixture.
- All 24 focused tests pass on macOS arm64 with Python 3.9.6, 3.12.15 and 3.14.8. Python 3.12 passes with warnings as errors; Python 3.14 passes under `-O`. Forty related source-binding and replay-bookkeeping tests pass on Python 3.12. The selected-record check and current-tree `--require-triggers` check pass. Ruff E4/E7/E9/F checks pass, with no additional diagnostics under the broader local configuration.
- A separate read-only review found no correctness issues. Hosted CI, Linux/Windows execution and the complete mathematical cold replay were not run locally. The reader retains its existing static YAML/glob limitations.

```sh
python3.12 -W error -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_selected_ci_inputs.py -v
python3.14 -I -O -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_selected_ci_inputs.py -v
python3.12 -I -B scripts/check_selected_ci_inputs.py --require-triggers
python3.12 -I -B scripts/verify_selected_result.py
```

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** tooling

Branch exclusions and unsupported branch globs now produce coverage errors. They fail the command only with `--require-triggers`. The production correction is two lines; the mathematical replay and frozen evidence are unchanged.
